import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")
    print(df.to_string())
    print()

import importlib.util

mods = ["zipfile", "xml.etree.ElementTree", "lxml", "openpyxl", "pandas", "xlrd"]
for m in mods:
    print(m, importlib.util.find_spec(m) is not None)

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
R = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'

def q(tag):
    return f'{{{M}}}{tag}'

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    wbroot = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    relroot = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rels = {rel.get("Id"): rel.get("Target").lstrip("/") for rel in relroot}
    sh = wbroot.find(q("sheets"))[0]
    rid = sh.get(f'{{{R}}}id')
    target = rels[rid] if rels[rid].startswith("xl/") else "xl/" + rels[rid]
    sroot = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))

    cells = {}
    for c in sroot.iter(q("c")):
        ref = c.get("r")
        v = c.find(q("v"))
        if v is not None:
            cells[ref] = float(v.text)

# Expense items are in column C, rows 11-22; category in column A, name in column B
expense_rows = range(11, 23)
items = []
by_cat = {}
total = 0.0
for r in expense_rows:
    val = cells.get(f"C{r}")
    if val is None:
        continue
    cat = cells.get(f"A{r}")
    name = cells.get(f"B{r}")
    items.append((cat, name, val))
    total += val
    by_cat[cat] = by_cat.get(cat, 0.0) + val

print("Per-item expenses:")
for cat, name, val in items:
    print(f"  {cat} / {name}: {val:g}")
print("\nPer-category totals:")
for cat, subtotal in by_cat.items():
    print(f"  {cat}: {subtotal:g}")
print(f"\nTOTAL EXPENSES: {total:g}")

income_total = sum(cells.get(f"B{r}", 0.0) for r in range(4, 8))
print(f"Total income (for reference): {income_total:g}")
print(f"Balance (income - expenses): {income_total - total:g}")
